name: SSL G Bus Compressor
notes: Probed 2026-11-23 (UADx). Attack, release and ratio are stepped and read from their labels; Auto release carries as auto. Threshold, make-up and mix report the 0-1 position, so they're read through a measured table.
Power stands in for the compressor's in/out. Fade and the side-chain filter come back as you left them.
